title: Pretérito o Imperfecto: Practice
description: Authored B1 practice set for choosing between the two past tenses: completed events vs background and habit, interrupted actions, descriptions of age/time/weather, and the verbs that change meaning (saber, conocer, querer, poder).

lessons.summary: The preterite reports WHAT HAPPENED: completed events with a start or end, one after another ('Ayer fuimos al parque, comimos y volvimos'). The imperfect paints the BACKGROUND: what was going on, what used to happen, descriptions ('Hacía sol, el bebé dormía, siempre paseábamos por ahí'). The classic frame is interruption: imperfect for the ongoing scene, preterite for what cut in ('Dormía la siesta cuando sonó el teléfono'). Age, clock time, weather and feelings as scene-setting go imperfect: 'Tenía dos años', 'Eran las tres', 'Llovía'. Habit markers (siempre, todos los días, de niño) pull toward imperfect; bounded markers (ayer, una vez, de repente, el lunes) pull toward preterite. Four verbs shift meaning between the tenses: sabía (knew) vs supe (found out); conocía (knew a person/place) vs conocí (met for the first time); quería (wanted) vs quise (tried) / no quise (refused); podía (was able, in general) vs pude (managed to).

examples.spanish: Dormía la siesta cuando sonó el timbre.
examples.english: He was napping when the doorbell rang.

examples.spanish: De niña, siempre pasaba los veranos en la playa.
examples.english: As a girl, I always spent summers at the beach.

examples.spanish: Ayer el bebé dio sus primeros pasos.
examples.english: Yesterday the baby took his first steps.

examples.spanish: Hacía frío y no había nadie en la plaza.
examples.english: It was cold and there was nobody at the square.
Yesterday I found out you're pregnant. Congratulations!

items.prompt: El bebé dormía cuando ___ el teléfono.
items.promptEnglish: The baby was sleeping when the phone rang.
items.explanation: The ongoing nap is imperfect; the ring that interrupts it is a completed event: preterite.

items.prompt: ___ tranquilamente cuando el perro empezó a ladrar.
items.promptEnglish: She was sleeping peacefully when the dog started barking.
items.explanation: The scene in progress goes imperfect; empezó is the interruption.

items.prompt: De niño, siempre ___ a casa de mis abuelos los domingos. (ir)
items.promptEnglish: As a kid, I always went to my grandparents' on Sundays.
Yesterday Teo took his first steps.
items.explanation: A one-off completed event with a time marker (ayer) → preterite: dio.

items.prompt: Cuando ___ dos años, ya hablaba muchísimo.
items.promptEnglish: When she was two, she already talked a lot.
items.explanation: Age in the past is background description, so it takes the imperfect.

items.prompt: ___ las tres de la mañana cuando por fin se durmió.
items.promptEnglish: It was three in the morning when he finally fell asleep.
items.explanation: Clock time in the past sets the scene, so it takes the imperfect. The falling asleep is the preterite event.

items.prompt: ___ mucho, así que nos quedamos en casa. (llover)
items.promptEnglish: It was raining a lot, so we stayed home.
items.explanation: Weather as backdrop → imperfect; the decision (nos quedamos) is the event.

items.prompt: ___ a mi mujer en una fiesta en 2019.
items.promptEnglish: I met my wife at a party in 2019.
items.explanation: Conocer in the preterite = met for the first time. Conocía = already knew her.

items.prompt: Ayer ___ que vamos a tener otro bebé.
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday we found out we're having another baby.
items.explanation: Saber in the preterite = found out. Sabíamos = we already knew.

items.prompt: Le ofrecí el puré, pero no ___ comer nada.
items.promptEnglish: I offered him the purée, but he refused to eat anything.
items.explanation: No querer in the preterite = refused. No quería would just describe a lack of appetite.

items.prompt: Por fin ___ dormirlo sin el chupete. (poder, yo)
items.promptEnglish: I finally managed to get him to sleep without the dummy.
items.explanation: Poder in the preterite = managed to, on that occasion. Podía = was generally able.

items.prompt: Mientras el bebé ___, preparé la cena.
items.promptEnglish: While the baby was napping, I made dinner.
items.explanation: Mientras introduces the ongoing background (imperfect); preparé is the completed action inside it.

items.prompt: No ___ nadie en la plaza porque hacía frío. (haber)
items.promptEnglish: There was nobody at the square because it was cold.
items.explanation: Existence as scene description → imperfect: había.

items.prompt: Ayer lo bañé, le ___ el pijama y le leí un cuento.
items.promptEnglish: Yesterday I bathed him, put his pyjamas on and read him a story.
items.explanation: A chain of completed actions, one after another, all go preterite: bañé, puse, leí.
